posts.author: joppen78
posts.text: Vår Energi kjøper ConocoPhillips norske virksomhet! Vi blir en del av en gigant. Transaction highlights - Increased scale, operatorship, recovery potential and value creation across a world-class asset portfolio:   - Pro-forma 2026 production of around 550 kboepd, including BlueNord[2]   - Raises the long-term production target to above 500 kboepd into the mid -2030s   - Increases total reserves and resources to approximately 2.9 billion boe[3]   - Reserves and resource life of approximately 14 years[4 ]   - Adds operatorship of the Greater Ekofisk Area and related export infrastructure   - Adding a highly competent team strengthening the capacity and competence of the Vår Energi organisation   - Expected to deliver USD 700 million to USD 1 billion of synergies[5] and additional value creation potential, net present value post-tax   - Increased free cash flow generation and dividend capacity resulting in increased dividend guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026 to USD 450 million
